translations.web: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
translations.bsb: I chose their course and presided as chief. So I dwelt as a king among his troops, as a comforter of the mourners.
translations.kjv: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
translations.asv: I chose out their way, and sat as chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.
